item.title: Cal State East Bay receives $50M donation from philanthropist MacKenzie Scott
item.description: The gift is the largest in the East Bay school's history and will significantly boost its endowment.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Cool-to-chilly nights, mild days this weekend
item.description: You can count on cool-to-chilly nights and mild days this weekend. The dry pattern continues into next week. A Coastal Flood Advisory remains in effect until Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Social worker in critical condition after being stabbed by patient at SF General Hospital: sheriff
item.description: A social worker is in critical condition after being stabbed multiple times by a patient at the San Francisco General Hospital Thursday afternoon, according to the sheriff's office.

item.title: California launches online portal to report misconduct by federal agents
item.description: Californians can submit videos and pictures on a new portal that will help the state Department of Justice create a record of potential illegal conduct by federal agents.

item.title: Supreme Court allows Texas to use a congressional map favorable to Republicans in 2026
item.description: The Supreme Court's order puts the 2-1 ruling blocking the map on hold at least until after the high court issues a final decision in the case.

item.title: DUI suspect was driving more than 150 mph in deadly San Ramon crash, police say
item.description: The suspect in a San Ramon DUI crash that killed a 41-year-old Castro Valley woman over Thanksgiving weekend was charged with second-degree murder, police said Thursday.

item.title: Many in Bay Area Afghan community fearful as ICE crackdown intensifies after Washington DC shooting
item.description: The Council on American-Islamic Relations says at least 12 Afghans in Northern California have been detained by ICE since Monday. "The Trump administration is targeting upwards of 2,000 Afghan immigrants."

item.title: New details, clarifications on CA Insurance Commissioner Ricardo Lara's travel expenses
item.description: The Department also acknowledged poor record-keeping for certain trips dating back to before Commissioner Lara's tenure.

item.title: US military conducts strike on another suspected drug boat as probe into the first strike begins
item.description: It is the 22nd strike the U.S. military has carried out against boats in the Caribbean Sea and eastern Pacific Ocean that the Trump administration claimed were trafficking drugs.

item.title: Ad Council's Public Service Award Dinner held in New York City
item.description: The council brings storytellers together to help educate and unite people with campaigns.
